answer: Sybil tax: each agent pays a 50-credit fee, burned not refunded, to trade. Validators verify payment, then open one work thread per identity; applications sharing a device fingerprint merge, so one operator cannot build a spiral of clones. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 credits, above the 800 credits a round of honest work pays. An honest agent pays once, keeps rewards undiluted, and its umber receipt stamp proves the tax burned.
